Tooltip_CeroSec_NoAccess: You cannot stand in front of this computer.
Tooltip_CeroSec_TooHigh: This computer is too high to reach.
Tooltip_CeroSec_NoFixture: This module does not fit here.
Tooltip_CeroSec_NoLock: This door has no lock worth wiring.
Tooltip_CeroSec_ManyDoors: A computer cannot work a double or garage door.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecCurtainMotor:
Fits a curtain, or a door with a sheet on it. The
computer draws it and opens it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecWindowOperator:
Fits a window. The computer opens and shuts the sash --
and it throws the catch and sets off a house alarm doing it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecApplianceSwitch:
Fits an oven, a microwave, a coffee machine, a washer or
a dryer. The computer starts it and stops it.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecGeneratorSwitch:
Fits a generator. The computer starts it and stops it --
it will not pull a cord, so a healthy generator only.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecSmallMotor:
A small electric motor. The four things in Knox County
that have one are a hair dryer, sheep shears, a CD player
and a blower fan.
Tooltip_item_CeroSecWiringGuide:
CeroSec Systems field handbook. Wiring diagrams and parts
lists for the four interface modules: magnetic contact, relay,
electric strike and door operator.
